scope: Re-verify the existing Android screenshot/input/revocation/cancel chain on the latest v2 source. No production source or test changes; fake ADB only, no real device.
command: uv run --no-sync pytest -q -n 0 agent/tests/v2/integrations/test_v2_android.py -k 'revocation or cancelled_capture or revoked_grant or cancelled_run_after_input or bad_png or malformed_ui or cancelled_waiter'
